9.1 Backup & Archive System – Overview

The ABpE Portal has an integrated backup and archive system that allows changes to important files to be saved and restored if necessary. The system is implemented as a CLI tool (backup_restore.py).

9.2 Directory Structure of the Archive

archive/
├── .gitignore                    # Ignores all backups
├── README.md                     # Backup documentation
├── index.json                    # Index of all backups
├── latest -> 2026-05-15/        # Symlink to the latest backup
└── 2026-05-15/                   # Date-based archives
    ├── manifest_143022.json      # Backup metadata
    └── apps/
        └── abpe_ui/
            ├── models_backup_20260515_143022.py
            ├── views_backup_20260515_143022.py
            └── templates/
                └── sidebar_backup_20260515_143022.html

9.3 backup_restore.py – CLI Tool

The backup tool is controlled from the command line and supports the following operations:

# Create a backup of a file
python backup_restore.py -save apps/abpe_ui/models.py -m "Multi-User Extension"

# List backups
python backup_restore.py -list apps/abpe_ui/models.py
python backup_restore.py -list --date 2026-05-15

# Restore a backup
python backup_restore.py -restore apps/abpe_ui/models.py
python backup_restore.py -restore apps/abpe_ui/models.py --version 20260515_143022

# Delete a backup
python backup_restore.py -delete apps/abpe_ui/models.py --version 20260515_143022

# Clean up old backups (older than 30 days)
python backup_restore.py -cleanup --days 30

9.4 Backup Process in Detail

When creating a backup, the following steps occur:

  1. Check if the file exists
  2. Generate a timestamp (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
  3. Copy the file to the archive while preserving the folder structure
  4. Calculate the MD5 checksum
  5. Add entry to the index (index.json) with metadata (original file, backup path, timestamp, size, checksum, user, message)
  6. Update the symlink latest/

9.5 Restoration Process

During restoration:

  1. Search for backup versions of the file
  2. Select the latest or a specific version
  3. Optional: Save the current file (.temp_backup)
  4. Copy the backup file to the original location
  5. Verify the checksum

9.6 Manifest.json – Metadata

Each backup directory contains a manifest.json with detailed metadata:

{
    "backup_date": "2026-05-15 14:30:22",
    "backup_by": "developer_name",
    "reason": "Multi-User Extension",
    "files": [
        {
            "original": "apps/abpe_ui/models.py",
            "backup": "models_backup_143022.py",
            "size": 15423,
            "checksum": "md5:abc123..."
        }
    ]
}

9.7 Cleanup of Old Backups

The system can automatically clean up old backups. It deletes all backup folders older than the specified number of days and removes the corresponding entries from the index.

python backup_restore.py -cleanup --days 30

9.8 Integration into Management Commands

The backup system is also available as a Django management command:

python manage.py backup_module apps/abpe_ui/models.py --reason "Reason for change"
